Presentation.Title: Odoo in switzerland: implementation and business modules
Presentation.Subtitle: A complete and scalable ERP solution
Intro: Odoo is a modular and flexible ERP solution, ideal for digitizing and optimizing your business management. Ark Fiduciaire supports you in the integration, customization, and evolution of your Odoo system.
We analyze your needs, configure the right modules, and train your teams to ensure rapid and effective adoption. Our technical support ensures the continuity and security of your Odoo environment.
Your team stays autonomous: automate routine tasks, extract data from invoices and receipts automatically, and build simple reports without IT.
Services: Odoo implementation: complete deployment and configuration of Odoo tailored to your business needs
Process automation: streamlining your workflows with automated administrative and operational tasks
Data migration: seamless transfer of your existing data to the new Odoo system
Training & support: comprehensive user training and ongoing technical assistance

Presentation.LongFormTitle: Odoo implementation focused on Swiss accounting

LongFormSections.Title: Who it is for
Body: Swiss SMEs, scale-ups, groups and finance teams that want to use Odoo for accounting, sales, purchasing and reporting.
The project is useful when current tools create duplicate entry, fragile exports or weak visibility.

LongFormSections.Title: What we configure
Body: Process scoping, Swiss chart of accounts, VAT, QR invoicing, accounting and business modules, data migration, user rights, dashboards and training.
We avoid over-configuration: each module must answer a clear operational or regulatory need.

LongFormSections.Title: Project method
Body: We start by mapping processes, prioritizing gaps and defining a testable scope before go-live.
Deliverables include backlog, configuration, migration controls, training materials and post-launch follow-up points.

LongFormSections.Title: Cost drivers
Body: Costs depend on module count, integrations, data quality, VAT rules, expected reporting and support level.
Ark Fiduciaire acts as an Odoo partner with Swiss accounting and fiduciary context.
